headline: Fed Officials Support Gradual Interest Rate Hikes to Curb Inflation
summary: Federal Reserve officials Hammack and Barkin have expressed support for a gradual path of interest rate increases to address ongoing inflation concerns.
why: Guidance from Federal Reserve officials is critical for market participants to gauge the future trajectory of monetary policy, which influences bond yields and equity valuations.

impacts.name: US Federal Funds Rate
impacts.why: Signals of rate hikes generally lead to higher yields and tighter financial conditions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of higher interest rates typically lead to a repricing of risk assets and an increase in government bond yields.
